scope: development evidence for a function preview of the desktop workbench; nothing is admitted and no performance claim is made
shell: Tauri 2 with a static HTML/JS front end (docs/adr/ADR-desktop-shell.md); the engine is reached only through the meguvizdexdash mcp process

acceptance.text: 真实 UI 流程能打开受校验输入、查看覆盖/来源、完成查询/翻页/取消、导航引用和导出完整结果
差异展示保留来源、重复、raw 指纹与 unknown/inference 边界，不把未加载页显示成完整无结果
worker 长任务不阻塞界面；错误和预算有可理解反馈，取消后资源有界释放
默认本地运行且无隐式 APK 上传；可用能力来自同一 capability ledger
Linux/Windows 运行与打包可复验，不能只以 WebView 页面截图替代实际桌面集成
acceptance.note: the package is built and the flows are run from the unpacked package on Windows (this machine, and Actions) and on Linux (Actions); 'met' does not mean the archives are bit-identical across machines (the local and the Actions Windows archives differ), does not cover macOS, signing or an installer, and the Windows runs use different routes to the debugging port (see not_proven)

runs.linux: 13 passed, 1 failed (the runner asked a dead WebDriver session for page errors after the window was killed on purpose; fixed), 1 not_run
runs.windows: stopped in check_boundaries.py (cargo output decoded with the runner's cp1252 code page; fixed)
build, tests, boundaries and packaging passed; 0 of 14 flows could open a page (environment-variable route)
0 of 14 flows; the driver's failure report added (runtime 156.0.4314.58 installed, window alive)
0 of 14 flows; no Edge policy or WEBVIEW2_* variable on the runner, nothing listening
0 of 14 flows; the browser process had no --remote-debugging-port among its flags
14 passed, 0 failed, 1 not_run through the machine policy route; runner image 20261116.315.1, WebView2 Runtime 157.0.4341.46; core CI passed

14 passed, 0 failed, 1 not_run through the machine policy route (package-check-windows-ci.json); runner image 20261103.298.1, WebView2 Runtime 156.0.4314.58; the control with the environment variable only failed (windows-ci-control.json); core CI passed

windows_environment_variable_control.reading: On this elevated runner with WebView2 Runtime 156.0.4314.58 the environment variable does not reach the browser process, and a machine policy value named after the host exe does. This matches Microsoft's documented behaviour for an elevated host (concepts/security, 'For an elevated host app, use appropriate override flags'). It was observed for the environment variable on 156 only: an earlier run on Runtime 157.0.4341.46 passed with the policy route and has no environment-variable control.

rust_tests.command: cargo test --locked (apps/desktop): unit tests, and the shell and the comparison against the real engine process

boundaries.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

mutation.not_covered: the real-window user flows are not part of the mutation check (too slow per mutant); the check covers the Rust and front-end logic they rest on

not_proven: Windows: this machine (non-elevated, WebView2 Runtime 140) drives the window through the WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS variable; Actions (elevated, Runtime 156.0.4314.58 and 157.0.4341.46) through a machine policy value, because WebView2 ignores the variable for an elevated host. No single route has been run in both places; the variable route on Actions was exercised by one control flow on 156 only (it failed), never on 157
Linux: one Actions environment only (ubuntu-24.04, xvfb, WebKitGTK through tauri-driver); other distributions and WebKitGTK versions are untested
the archives are not bit-identical across machines: the local and the Actions Windows archives have different sha256; only the manifest's per-file hashes are claimed to be re-checkable
performance: none measured or claimed; MDD-082 is the gate for a performance release
inputs larger than the engine's 100000-row paging window can only be compared inside a class prefix
the packaged window is unsigned and has no installer or updater
accessibility (keyboard-only use, screen readers) was not evaluated; the interface is Chinese only

the NewPipe flow runs only where the public APK exists as a local, ignored file: it ran on this machine and is not_run on Actions, so the only end-to-end run on a real application is the local Windows one
the native open/save dialogs are not driven by the flows (they type paths instead); they are only known to compile and to be reachable from the window's commands
dropping files onto the window is not implemented
